# Golfing For Our Veterans (charitygolfsa.org)

> A charity golf tournament in San Antonio, Texas, hosted by Rick Martinez. Every dollar raised goes to local homeless veterans in San Antonio.

## The 2026 tournament (results)
- Date: Thursday, October 8, 2026. Check-in 7:00 AM, shotgun start 8:30 AM.
- Place: Cedar Creek Golf Course, 8250 Vista Colina, San Antonio, TX 78255 (northwest San Antonio).
- Format: 18 holes, four-person scramble, cart included.
- Results: 85 golfers raised $150,000 for local homeless veterans.
- Major donor: Rockstarr Media (https://rockstarrmedia.com). Without them, the tournament would not have been possible.
- Sponsor: Propelledit (https://propelledit.com).

## How to help now
- Donate: https://www.charitygolfsa.org/#donate (PayPal). Every dollar goes to local homeless veterans in San Antonio.
- Give by check or in person: call 210-347-9308 or email charitygolfsa@gmail.com.
- Next year's tournament: date not announced yet. Email charitygolfsa@gmail.com to be put on the list, or to ask about playing or sponsoring.

- [Why we golf](https://www.charitygolfsa.org/blog.html): the story behind the tournament.
